title: Categorized Free Recall: Delayed Free Recall of Word Lists Organized by Semantic Categories
description: This dataset provides behavioral events and intracranial EEG recordings from a categorized delayed free recall task. Participants studied visually presented word lists built from 25 semantic categories, completed arithmetic distractor problems, and then freely recalled the words. Each 12-word list contains pairs of same-category words from three categories. Data were collected at multiple clinical sites in collaboration with the Computational Memory Lab at the University of Pennsylvania.
methods_description: Participants studied lists of 12 words presented one at a time, solved simple arithmetic problems as a distractor, and freely recalled the words in any order. Intracranial recordings were made on multiple systems and scaled to volts, with monopolar and bipolar montages provided. Subject-specific electrode locations include MNI and Talairach coordinates and brain region annotations when available.
